description: Emma is a foster coordinator preparing 6 cats for an adoption event. Her information is scattered in messy notes at /home/ga/Documents/foster_notes.txt. Open the blank spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/foster_cats_adoption.xlsx and organize all 6 cats into a structured adoption readiness tracker. Required columns: Cat Name, Age Category (Kitten/Young Adult/Adult/Senior), Sex, Weeks in Foster (calculate from notes), Medical Status (Healthy/Special Needs/Treatment Pending), Behavioral Notes, Adoption Readiness (Ready Now/Needs More Time/Special Placement). Extract data from the notes file, calculate time in foster, and categorize each cat appropriately. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
